name: smwmusic-final-fantasy-vii-reunion
title: Final Fantasy VII - Reunion
description:
Ported by request.

6 custom samples (8.89KiB) based on the original ones. The flute is original due to not being able to find a decent version of the original sample, and a square wave was layered over the e-piano sample to reduce polyphony.

Tweaked the envelopes and echo a fair bit from the original, because IMHO, the original was a bit choppy, making it a bit annoying to listen to for extended periods of time.

Re-uploaded for improvements: Saved 181 bytes(!), swapped pizzicato (now in Ch6) with a string channel (now in Ch7), and starting to place all my samples into a single folder.
